svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Superpose to compare series; facet to see each series' shape
Occlusion plus a nine-item legend. Neither shape nor comparison survives.
Nine small multiples, shared scales, each with the others in grey behind it
The faceted version needs no legend, no colour discrimination, and survives greyscale — the viewer learns the encoding once
and then compares patterns. Panels are sorted, so the grid also delivers a ranking for free.
